methodologyNotes: Prices fetched directly from official vendor pricing pages on 2026-06-15. All plans are per-screen subscriptions unless noted. NoviSign publishes its $18/$26/$44 prices as annual-billing rates (save 10%) and explicitly publishes month-to-month rates of $20/$29/$49; monthlyUsd records the annual-billing rate and annualDiscountPct is set to 10 to match the stated savings. OptiSigns explicitly publishes both monthly and annual rates, enabling exact annualDiscountPct (~10%). Yodeck lists $8/$11/$15/screen/month as its standard pricing (billed annually); no separate month-to-month price was found on the pricing page so monthlyUsd reflects the published per-screen rate and annualDiscountPct is set to null. Rise Vision lists $11/$13 as month-to-month rates with 9%/12% stated savings on annual — annualized effective monthly rates are $10.01 and $11.44 respectively; monthlyUsd records the listed month-to-month price to avoid computed guesses, and annualDiscountPct records the stated percentage. ScreenCloud's annual rate was not disclosed on the pricing page (annual toggle exists but no price rendered); monthlyUsd records the published month-to-month rates. Kitcast annual prices ($7/$10/screen) are explicitly published giving computable discounts (22% and 29%). G2 returned HTTP 403; Capterra confirmed Yodeck/ScreenCloud/OptiSigns/Rise Vision/NoviSign starting prices as corroboration. hipaa/baa/bilingual fields are null unless explicitly stated on vendor pages. minutesIncluded/callsIncluded/overagePerMin/overagePerCall = null on all plans (non-telephony vertical).
